title: Bihar: 13 dead after boat capsizes in Vaishali; CM announces Rs 4 lakh ex-gratia
content: In a heart-wrenching event in the Raghopur Diara vicinity of Vaishali district, a boat capsized, tragically involving many children. The local community is in distress, with RJD leader Tejashwi Yadav voicing his grief and urging immediate rescue actions. The administration is actively working to hasten relief efforts and support victims, while officials keep a vigilant watch on the unfolding situation.

title: US issues power grid emergency in 13 states: Reason and what it means for residents
content: In a decisive move to ensure grid stability during a peak demand period, US Secretary of Energy Chris Wright has empowered PJM Interconnection to manage local power generation units from October 13 to October 16. With temperatures hitting unseasonably high levels, demand has surged to approximately 111,500 megawatts on October 13. While residents are not required to take action, voluntary conservation measures may be recommended.

title: FIR against CJP leaders after Jantar Mantar entry, breach of peace bond alleged

The FIR includes violations of a peace bond previously signed by the leaders. CJP members protested against the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. Tensions escalated after police tightened security at Jaffarpur Kalan Police Station due to protests.

title: Ohio brothers bought flooded quarry for $330,000; village later drops seizure bid
content: Two Ohio brothers bought a flooded quarry for $330,000 in 2005 and spent 15 years improving it before a dispute with the Village of Luckey disrupted their planned sale. After nearly five years of litigation, the village abandoned its attempt to acquire the property through eminent domain but now faces a $206,000 legal bill, with the settlement still under dispute.Is this conversation helpful so far?

title: Ronaldo’s UAE golden visa: How he keeps residency without owning property
content: Cristiano Ronaldo received the UAE Golden Visa in 2020, years before moving to Saudi Arabia’s Al-Nassr. Recognised for his achievements as an elite athlete, he qualified without needing to invest in Dubai property or establish a business. The programme’s long-term residency benefits explain how Ronaldo can continue living and playing in Saudi Arabia while maintaining ties with the neighbouring Emirates.

title: Ashok Lavasa says EC must regain public trust amid SIR controversy
content: Ashok Lavasa stressed the importance of the Election Commission regaining trust during recent protests over electoral roll irregularities. He highlighted concerns regarding the integrity of the Special Intensive Revision exercise and its impact on voter rights. The commission's credibility is questioned due to dissent among its members and lack of transparency in decision-making. Prakash Raj labeled the exercise as detrimental to democracy, extending criticism to ruling party actions.

title: Tech billionaire’s firm controls 2,700 Somerset acres as locals debate expansion
content: In 2013, Koos Bekker's acquisition of Hadspen House sparked a transformative expansion into The Newt in Somerset, encompassing over 2,700 acres. This growth has generated local employment and attracted visitors, yet opinions remain divided. Many residents welcome the job opportunities, while others voice concerns about the estate's impact on community identity, land stewardship, and environmental sustainability, illustrating the complexity of fostering development without compromising local values.

title: California man paid $2 for old photos; one was later insured for $5 million
content: Randy Guijarro discovered an old photograph believed to include Billy the Kid in 2010, purchased for just $2. This photograph has been appraised at $5 million and may confirm its authenticity. After extensive research, experts linked the image to Billy the Kid’s social life during the late summer of 1878. The image also represents a more human side of the infamous outlaw.

title: USCIS warns immigrants: Update home address within 10 days or risk missing documents
content: US Citizenship and Immigration Services mandates that immigrants notify them of any address changes within 10 days. Failure to report changes may lead to missed immigration documents and important notices. Changing the address with the USPS alone is insufficient, as it does not update USCIS records automatically. USCIS encourages using their online system for immediate processing of address changes.

title: Kentucky widow wins half of $2.33m accounts after husband dies without will
content: A Kentucky appeals court has upheld a widow’s right to half of her late husband’s $2.33 million investment accounts, despite his children being named as beneficiaries. William E. Perrine died without a will in 2024. The court also ruled that his widow, Nancy, was entitled to half of $126,000 gifted to his children and grandchildren shortly before his death.

title: Travis Kelce’s 87 & Running Foundation: How is it supporting students amid controversy?

title: Former Haryana CM Bhupinder Singh Hooda admitted to AIIMS with chest infection

His hospitalization has stirred goodwill among political opponents, with leaders from both the BJP and INLD extending wishes for his swift recovery. This incident underscores the underlying camaraderie in Haryana politics, despite the competitive landscape, especially recognizing Hooda's legacy as a former chief minister.

title: Can Old Monk be sold as rum? FSSAI, manufacturer lock horns in Bombay high court

FSSAI says the spirit can’t be sold simply as “rum” if it uses added flavouring, and wants a “rum-like” label. The Bombay high court, which refused interim relief, will hear the matter again on October 23.

Achieving his career-best with a six-wicket haul, Hazlewood ended up with eight wickets. This stellar performance was pivotal in Australia's commanding 214-run win, solidifying his status as one of the greatest fast bowlers in Australia's Test history.

title: IIT Kanpur alumnus, 61, struggles to find US tech job for nearly two years

Financial hardships have forced him to turn to gig work and launch a GoFundMe fundraiser for support. With numerous job applications yielding no success and debts mounting, the uncertainty of his future is prompting him to think about relocating back to India as he nears eligibility for Social Security.

title: US school bus driver removed from route after letting 10-year-old rescue kitten

title: RBI steps in with big measures for rupee, but should it let currency fall instead?

title: TOI explains: Why can’t Bengaluru protest outside Freedom Park?
content: the law is more nuanced than an absolute ban on demonstrations elsewhere . the practice emerged from a suo motu Karnataka high court case initiated in 2021 over the effect of demonstrations on traffic and the rights of people not participating in them .
